_comment: Radiance x0 patch-16 SINGLE-GPU offload LoRA fine-tune. See radiance/train.py. The whole 9.5B model is diced into one chunk per block (64 chunks: embed + 19 double + 38 single + nerf-embed + 4 NerfGLUBlock + head) and streams from pinned CPU RAM through a small GPU window; the frozen T5-XXL encoder streams the same way. Needs ~24 GB host RAM for the bf16 masters + grad accumulators + AdamW state on the LoRA params. There is NO VAE: the model reads and writes pixels, and the dataloader's [-1, 1] images are already the target.
_comment_topology: parallelism: 'offload' = 1 GPU with weight streaming, 'pipeline' = N GPUs resident, 'pipeline-offload' = N GPUs with streaming. Independent of 'mode' (lora/full), which is the fine-tuning target. devices defaults to cuda:0 for offload.
_comment_chunks: blocks_per_chunk: transformer blocks per streamed chunk (1 = finest; doubles, singles and NeRF blocks never share a chunk). offload_window: GPU slots streamed ahead (>=2 overlaps load with compute). offload_pin: chunks kept permanently resident. offload_backward: 'checkpoint' (per-chunk recompute, dropout-safe, cheapest VRAM) or 'keep' (fastest, holds every chunk's graph). offload_grad_accum: where microbatch gradients accumulate — 'cpu' for LoRA (small trainable slice, host adds are cheap), 'stream' for full FT. enc_layers_per_chunk: T5-XXL layers per encoder chunk (24 layers; 4 -> 6 chunks of ~680M).
_comment_batch: batch_size is PER MICROBATCH; effective batch = batch_size * n_microbatches.
_comment_timeshift: Resolution-aware shifted logit-uniform schedule, unchanged from chroma: mu = ln(alpha) interpolated between (256px, 0.5) and (1024px, 1.15) in IMAGE-TOKEN count. Patch 16 on pixels gives the same token counts as chroma's f8 VAE + patch 2 (8*2 = 16), so these anchors transfer exactly.
_comment_attn: attn_padding: number of T5 padding tokens after each caption left attendable (flow's modify_mask_to_attend_padding).
_comment_eval: eval_interval: steps between preview grids (0 disables previews; each preview streams the whole model once per CFG branch per sampler step). Previews need no decode — the model emits pixels.
_comment_txt_pos: RoPE axis-0 positions for the TEXT stream: 'zeros' (chroma's convention) or 'arange' (flow's radiance.py::make_text_position_ids). SETTLED EMPIRICALLY for latest_x0.safetensors: 'zeros' scores 7.7% lower training loss on 8/8 real samples and 'arange' streaks visibly at 512px. Re-run radiance/tools/check_txt_pos_ids.py if you ever point radiance_checkpoint at a differently-trained base.
_comment_ckpt: Path to the Radiance x0 patch-16 base weights (safetensors, native flow keys, 659 tensors). See checkpoints/README.md.
_comment_mode: mode='lora' (default): LoRA adapters on all nn.Linear + unfrozen RMSNorm scales, whole model bf16 (halves PCIe traffic vs fp32). mode='full': fp32 masters + bf16 autocast compute — see train_offload_full.json for the host-RAM budget. In full mode, resume priority: full_checkpoint > lora_checkpoint (merged into radiance_checkpoint) > radiance_checkpoint.
_comment_lora: lora_exclude_prefixes: the frozen Approximator, plus nerf_image_embedder — Linear(67 -> 64) at p16, where a rank-32 adapter is larger than the layer it adapts. frozen_prefixes drops matching params from the optimizer; the Approximator also runs under no_grad inside the embed chunk.
